subject: stf
title: STF.------POL.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 430 (MP(I)-4). STF (source transfer) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names POL-DY (political dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: POL-DYM (political dynamics), TM (terminology—or terms of a definition) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From TM: INT (intention) and AF-NT (affinity nature). From MT-INFO: TRS (transition). From AF-NT: CN-INFO (controlled information) and SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). From TRS: ALT-D (alternative definitions). From SOC-RT-P: ALT-F (alternative functionalism).
